text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer devises a strategy for the 
Hopeful Stakes just for Tosen Jordan. 
However, she struggles to wrap her head 
around it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then it's time for a change of plans! The 
Trainer helped her understand the strategy 
through hands-on experience and simpler 
terms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan safely grasps the strategy. 
Hyped up, she boldly declares her next 
goal to be the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she had researched the 
races herself and set goals for the 
future. It offered a brief glimpse into 
her true motivation.
